item.title: Episode 1: Namespaces All the Way Down
item.description:
• Pre-show: what a namespace prefix actually binds to
  • Follow-up:
    • An episode note that nests a list inside a list item
    • Escaping <rss> inside markup the parser must not treat as elements
    • Curly punctuation that arrives as raw UTF-8: the parser’s job is to pass it through
  • Ask Example: “does description or itunes:summary win?”
item.content:encoded:
The long-form show notes for episode one, delivered in content:encoded rather than description.

item.title: Episode 2: Fallbacks, Defaults & Entities
item.description: Plain RSS description for episode two, with an escaped ampersand (&), an escaped apostrophe ('), an escaped quote (") and a raw non-ASCII dash — all of which must survive the parser.
item.itunes:title: Fallbacks and Defaults
item.itunes:author: Example Media Collective
item.itunes:summary: An itunes:summary delivered as CDATA that is indented away from its own tags, so the parser sees leading and trailing whitespace around the payload.
